description_en: Queries whether ARMS monitoring is enabled for a specified application
description_zh: 查询指定app是否开启应用监控
name: QueryArmsEnable

Code.description_en: The status code or error code. Valid values: 2xx: The request was successful. 3xx: The request was redirected. 4xx: The request was invalid. 5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh: 接口状态或pop错误码。取值说明如下：-2xx：成功。-3xx：重定向。-4xx：请求错误。-5xx：服务器错误

Enable.description_en: Indicates if enabled. Valid values: true and false
Enable.description_zh: 是否启用。取值说明如下：-true：启用-false：禁用

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. Value description:

If the request was successful, this field is not returned.

For more information, see the Error codes section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The additional information. Value description:

If the request was successful, success is returned.

If the request failed, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：成功。
false：失败

TraceId.description_en: The ID of the trace, which is used to query the details of a request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链id，用于精确查询调用信息
